entry.description: A buffering appender that fixes less than `All`, such as `BufferingForwardingAppender` with `Partial`, no longer hides the identity, location, thread name, domain, message and exception text from the appenders after it in the same logging call. The thread delivering the event may now fill in what the fix left out; once the delivery ended, the event stays locked as before (ANT-2026-JY0R8A0K, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
